search.needKeysBody: The shared server keys are only for the first users. To search and add new entries, enter your own key in your profile.
search.adultBlocked: Adult content is hidden. You can enable it in your profile.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sharedInfo: The first {limit} users may use the shared server keys. Want to use your own? Enter them below (optional).
profile.requiredInfo: You are user #{number} (after the first {limit}). To add new movies/games from the databases you MUST enter your own API keys below.
profile.emptyHint: Leave a field empty — the value will not change. Keys are visible only to you.
profile.langHint: Choose the interface language. New imports fetch descriptions in this language too. You can switch it any time in the top bar.
profile.themeHint: Pick a colour theme for the whole portal. Applies instantly and is saved for next time.
profile.adultHint: Off by default: adult content is hidden in search and refused on import. Turn on at your own risk.
profile.refreshAllHint: Older entries were saved in a single language. This re-fetches every imported movie / series / game from the source and fills in all three languages, so switching language re-labels them instantly. May take a while for large libraries.
